publication.title: Test-Agent: A Multimodal App Automation Testing Framework Based on the Large Language Model
publication.venue: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Digital Twins and Parallel Intelligence (DTPI)

name: Test-Agent: A Multimodal App Automation Testing Framework Based on the Large Language Model
notes: Harmony OS Next and mini-programs are named as emerging systems that motivate cross-platform testing. The framework works from screenshots and UI structure information without prewritten test scripts or backend access.
summary: Test-Agent uses an LLM, screenshots, and interface structure to generate and execute mobile app test actions from natural-language instructions across platforms.
